verdict.rationale: The evidence only mentions 'Skills' as modular instruction sets that extend Cline's capabilities for specific tasks, which is tangential to a dedicated project-wide instructions/coding-standards file rather than a clear equivalent of a rules file. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a project-level instructions/rules file (e.g. a .clinerules-style config), guidance on setting coding standards/conventions, and any community corroboration of this specific feature.
